586-678-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
586-678-8227.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4279-5933-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5933-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6723-6968.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-4823-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-4823-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-4823-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Timeless Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

3129-4772-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-6968-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6968-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Kratos can be omitted.

1379-2685-2919-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-2919-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2685-2919-3197-3263.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-2919-3197-3263.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-2604-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken colorless creature.
You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-2604-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting the colorless creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
The Equipment's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Ugin.
Repeat.

997-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1563-2457-4478-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

550-1618-2440-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer
550-1618-2440-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Young Pyromancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
550-1618-2440-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

338-5086-5183-5231-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-5086-5183-5231-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

1409-4716-5184.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1251-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1251-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

1479-2692-2841-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2692-2841-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2558-5226-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

3239-4050-5220-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3168-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

5465-6867-6869.description:
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

803-4338-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-5641-6752.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

149-3755-4831.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2167-5310-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5310-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Bloodghast triggers that many times, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing Bloodghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

7-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-4484-4871-5256-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

238-5231-5756.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gerrard, adding {R}.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Havi, adding {R}.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-851-2793-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
392-851-2793-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

730-880-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
730-880-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1651-2034-2797-4365.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

222-4871-5111-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling, and at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-4871-5111-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1409-2208-4365.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-2208-4365.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

648-3304.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of cards in your library.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, then discard three cards.

190-3473.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is at least twenty.
190-3473.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Transcendence and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Transcendence.
Each opponent's copy of Transcendence triggers, causing them to lose the game.

3573-3932-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
You control at least two artifacts.
3573-3932-4222.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Tolarian Academy and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
